event.name: O1 Visa Strategy and Fireside Chat
event.description:
Join us for an informative session on the O-1 visa pathway for founders, builders, researchers, engineers, and community leaders.

Guest speaker Karishma Mandal will share practical insights on building a strong O-1 profile, preparing your application, and showcasing your impact through achievements, publications, speaking opportunities, community involvement, and other forms of recognition.

Whether you are exploring the O-1 path or actively preparing your application, this event will help you understand the process and connect with others on a similar journey.
event.location: Homebrew Club, 111 Maiden Ln #540, San Francisco, CA 94108

sponsors.companyDescription: O-1 Assist is an AI-powered platform that helps exceptional professionals prepare strong O-1, EB-1A, and Global Talent visa applications. It streamlines the entire petition process by helping applicants build qualifying evidence, organize documentation, and connect with experienced immigration attorneys for filing.

partners.companyDescription: Homebrew Club is a modern co-working space designed for founders, creators, freelancers, and professionals looking for a productive environment to work, collaborate, and build. It provides flexible workspaces, a vibrant community, and resources that help individuals and teams grow their ideas into successful ventures.
